limits: Existing scene, panel and action contracts retain their component-specific restrictions.

convention.name: media
convention.meaning: Consumer-supplied media content in a component, including scene media and neutral section media.
convention.whenToUse: Supply scene media or meaningful and interactive media in a neutral section, subject to each component contract.
convention.avoid: Effect selectors or Radix asChild composition; existing scene contracts remain decorative only.

convention.name: social
convention.meaning: Consumer-supplied social content in a scene or neutral section.
convention.whenToUse: Supply social-profile links or other social content according to the component contract.
convention.avoid: Structured data arrays or unrelated content; existing scene contracts remain unchanged.

convention.name: header
convention.meaning: Consumer-supplied introductory content at the start of a panel or neutral section.
convention.whenToUse: Supply a panel introduction or a neutral section header, subject to the component contract.
convention.avoid: Text that is a panel's only accessible name; existing panel contracts retain their restrictions.

convention.name: actions
convention.meaning: Consumer-supplied action content in a component or neutral section.
convention.whenToUse: Supply action elements or neutral section action content subject to the component contract.
convention.avoid: Generating controls from data inside the component; existing component contracts retain their restrictions.

convention.name: body
convention.meaning: Consumer-supplied body content of a neutral section.
convention.whenToUse: Supply the main section content, including interactive nodes.
convention.avoid: The section landmark or a replacement for header, media, actions or social slots.
